w:r.w:t: The application utilizes a decoupled Client-Server architecture designed for high availability on Alibaba Cloud and a redirection latency of
React.js SPA for the Grid View, Admin Console, and User Profile Management.
Node.js/Express.js REST API for authentication, RBAC, metadata CRUD, and secure token generation.
Alibaba Cloud RDS (PostgreSQL) for relational data and audit trails.
Redis (ApsaraDB) for session management and fast token retrieval.
Strict environment parity is maintained across three stages using separate .env files.
The schema is expanded to support RBAC, Business Units, and Security Policies.
System validates email domain against Allowed_Domains. If invalid, return
New registrations default to Employee unless modified by a SuperAdmin.
Users can view their assigned BU and email.
Users can update passwords via PATCH /me/password. Requires old_password validation.
Frontend fetches a JWE token from the API.
The token is passed to the target app via the
No tokens are passed in the URL.
Full access to Applications, BUs, Domains, and User Role assignments.
Restricted access to manage Applications specifically assigned to their own Business Unit.
On login, if current_date - password_changed_at > 90 days, the API returns a PASSWORD_EXPIRED challenge. User is forced to a password reset page before accessing the Grid.
Timestamp, Trace ID, Log Level, and Performance Metadata.
Immutable audit_logs table records all Admin actions and User Management changes:
actor_id, action_type (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, ROLE_CHANGE), target_entity, payload_before, payload_after, ip_address.
Eliminates token exposure in browser history and logs.
SuperAdmin bypass or hardcoded root domain for recovery.
Initial draft: Basic SSO and Admin CRUD.
Added Domain Whitelisting and Business Units.
Security Hardening: Token moved to Headers.
Full Integration of PRD v3.0: BU selection at reg, Password Retype, User Management, Admin RBAC, and Password Expiry.
